metadata.title: Trustora — Trust. Verify. Shop.
metadata.description: Digital trust infrastructure for Sri Lankan social commerce.

home.title: Know who you are buying from — before you pay.
home.body: Trustora brings verified business identity, real transaction outcomes and transparent evidence together, so customers can make informed decisions and honest Sri Lankan SMEs can stand out.

business.title: Business Trust
business.question: Can I trust this business?
business.body: Verified identity, documentation, contact details, linked social accounts and platform history.

product.title: Product Trust
product.question: Can I trust this product?
product.body: Product information, supplier and authenticity evidence, and customer reports.

transaction.title: Transaction Trust
transaction.question: Can I trust this transaction?
transaction.body: Completed orders, delivery performance, refunds, disputes and verified reviews.

home.principleBody: Trustora never claims a seller is 100% safe. Trust levels describe what the available verified and observed evidence shows today, and they change as new evidence arrives.

auth.signupSubtitle: Choose how you will use Trustora.
auth.accountTypeCustomerHint: Shop from verified businesses and track your orders.
auth.accountTypeSmeHint: Create a verified store and build your Trust Passport.
